purpose: First separate oracle uncertainty-aware risk response from the ability of the existing learned Density score to approximate that oracle, with the ORION planner frozen.
selection_rule: Carry a route into the causal matrix only if clean_off is valid and corrupt_off worsens a safety outcome. If fewer than two hazard families pass, repeat severity 2 on all three routes before adding routes.
interpretation_limit: The learned Density score is a time-aligned anomaly trigger, not known semantically correct UQ. No result here is evidence that the LLM understands uncertainty.
